reasoning: The question asks if 95%+ of Nigerians aged 18+ will have a bank account before January 1, 2025. However, the forecast date is October 16, 2025—already past the resolution deadline. The evidence shows Nigeria had ~60 million bank accounts (out of 200+ million citizens) as of September 2025, far below 95%. The 2019 CBN goal to reach 95% by 2024 was not met. Recent 2025 data indicates Nigeria aims for 80% financial inclusion by 2030, suggesting the 95% target was abandoned. The new tax law requiring TINs for bank accounts (effective January 2026) may actually exclude unbanked populations. No evidence indicates 95% was achieved by end-2024. The question should resolve negatively.
